video_title: The Insta360 Luna Ultra review they didn't pay for
evidence: SponsorRadar identifies XGIMI sponsoring Becca Farsace's July 7, 2026 English-language YouTube video and quotes the description thanking @XGIMITech for sponsoring. SponsorRadar also reports XGIMI has sponsored dozens of YouTube creators and shows additional August 2026 creator spend, including Jordan Pulmano (~44K subscribers) on August 10, 2026, demonstrating active spend at small/mid-size creator levels. XGIMI sells tangible physical consumer projectors/home-cinema hardware. XGIMI's current official affiliate program explicitly invites influencers, reviewers and content creators, says the team is open to deeper collaborations, and publishes affiliate@xgimi.com for program questions.
